news.text: After coming into Wednesday night averaging just 15.3 points through 11 games, James Harden turned in a throwback performance with a season-high 32 points to lead the Cavaliers to a 115-107 victory over the Knicks.

news.title: James Harden scores a season-high 32 points as the Cavaliers beat the Knicks 115-107
